faq-teaser.question: What is a credit and how many do I need?
faq-teaser.answer: One credit equals one AI generation. A typical landing page uses 1–3 credits depending on complexity and the number of revisions you make.

faq-teaser.question: Can I edit the code after exporting?
faq-teaser.answer: Absolutely. Exported code is clean, well-commented, and framework-standard — you can open it in any editor and customise it freely.

faq-teaser.question: Do I need to know how to code?
faq-teaser.answer: Not at all. Builder is designed for everyone from non-technical founders to senior engineers who want to move faster.

faq-teaser.question: What frameworks does Builder export to?
faq-teaser.answer: We currently support Next.js 14, plain HTML/CSS/JS, and React with Tailwind CSS. More frameworks are coming soon.

faq-accordion.question: What is Builder by HotCode AI?
faq-accordion.answer: Builder by HotCode AI is an AI-powered website generator that turns a plain-text description of your project into a fully production-ready website in under 60 seconds. No coding knowledge is required — just describe what you want and the AI handles design, layout, and code.

faq-accordion.question: Do I need to know how to code to use Builder?
faq-accordion.answer: Not at all. Builder is designed for everyone — from non-technical founders and marketers to experienced developers who want to move faster. You describe your site in plain English, and the AI writes all the code for you.

faq-accordion.question: How do I create my first website?
faq-accordion.answer: Sign up for a free account, click 'Start Building', type a description of your website (e.g. 'A landing page for a yoga studio in Brooklyn with a booking form and testimonials'), and hit Generate. Your site will be ready in seconds.

faq-accordion.question: What kinds of websites can I build?
faq-accordion.answer: Builder works for landing pages, portfolios, SaaS marketing sites, restaurant pages, event pages, agency sites, personal blogs, and more. Browse the Examples page to see the full range of what's possible.

faq-accordion.question: What are credits?
faq-accordion.answer: Credits are the currency used to generate websites inside Builder. Each generation consumes a set number of credits depending on the complexity of your request. Free accounts start with 50 credits — enough to build and iterate several times.

faq-accordion.question: How much do credits cost?
faq-accordion.answer: We offer four credit packs: Free (50 credits), Starter ($10 for 100 credits), Growth ($23 for 250 credits), and Scale ($42 for 500 credits). Credits never expire, so you can use them at your own pace.

faq-accordion.question: Do unused credits roll over?
faq-accordion.answer: Yes. Credits do not expire and roll over indefinitely. Whether you buy a pack today or six months from now, your balance will always be waiting for you when you log back in.

faq-accordion.question: Can I get a refund on unused credits?
faq-accordion.answer: We offer refunds on unused credit packs within 14 days of purchase, provided fewer than 20% of the credits in that pack have been used. Please contact our support team via the Contact page to request a refund.

faq-accordion.question: What is the difference between the Starter, Builder, Pro, and Scale plans?
faq-accordion.answer: Starter is free and gives you 50 credits to explore the platform. Builder ($9/mo) adds unlimited exports and custom domains. Pro ($29/mo) unlocks priority AI generation, white-label exports, and advanced analytics. Scale is a custom enterprise plan with dedicated support and SLA guarantees.

faq-accordion.question: Is there a free plan?
faq-accordion.answer: Yes. The Starter plan is completely free — no credit card required. You get 50 generation credits, access to all templates, and the ability to export your site's code.

faq-accordion.question: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan at any time?
faq-accordion.answer: Absolutely. You can change your plan at any time from your account dashboard. Upgrades take effect immediately; downgrades apply at the start of your next billing cycle.

faq-accordion.question: Do you offer discounts for startups or students?
faq-accordion.answer: Yes. We offer a 40% discount for verified students and early-stage startups (under $500K in funding). Apply via the Contact page with proof of eligibility.

faq-accordion.question: What does 'production ready' mean?
faq-accordion.answer: Every site generated by Builder is clean, semantic, and optimized — including responsive layouts, accessible HTML, optimized images, and a Lighthouse score above 90. You can deploy it directly without any cleanup.

faq-accordion.question: How do I export my website?
faq-accordion.answer: Click the 'Export' button in the editor. You'll receive a ZIP file containing your full site — HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and any assets. On Builder and higher plans you can also push directly to GitHub or deploy to Vercel with one click.

faq-accordion.question: Which hosting platforms are supported?
faq-accordion.answer: Builder-generated sites are static-first and work on any hosting platform: Vercel, Netlify, GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, AWS S3, or any traditional web host. One-click deploy integrations are available on the Builder plan and above.

faq-accordion.question: Can I use a custom domain?
faq-accordion.answer: Yes. Custom domain support is included on the Builder plan ($9/mo) and above. You can connect any domain you own through your account dashboard in a few clicks.

faq-accordion.question: How does the AI generate my website?
faq-accordion.answer: Builder uses a combination of large language models and a proprietary design system to interpret your description, choose an appropriate layout, generate clean code, and apply a cohesive visual style — all in a single pass.

faq-accordion.question: Can I edit the generated site after it's created?
faq-accordion.answer: Yes. After generation you can tweak copy, swap colors, rearrange sections, and adjust layouts directly in the visual editor. You can also re-prompt the AI to regenerate specific sections without starting over.

faq-accordion.question: What if I don't like the first result?
faq-accordion.answer: Just refine your prompt and regenerate. Each new generation uses one credit. You can also use the 'Variations' feature to generate three alternative designs from the same prompt and pick your favorite.

faq-accordion.question: Does Builder support multiple languages?
faq-accordion.answer: Yes. You can describe your website in any major language and the AI will generate content in that language. The Builder interface itself is currently available in English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, and Japanese.

faq-accordion.question: Is my data safe?
faq-accordion.answer: Yes. All data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256). We do not sell your data to third parties, and your generated websites are private by default — only you can see them until you choose to publish or export.

faq-accordion.question: Who owns the websites I create?
faq-accordion.answer: You do. All content and code generated through your account belongs entirely to you. Builder retains no rights to your output.

faq-accordion.question: Is Builder GDPR compliant?
faq-accordion.answer: Yes. Builder is fully GDPR compliant. We act as a data processor on your behalf, maintain a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) available on request, and honor all data subject rights including the right to erasure.

faq-accordion.question: How do I get help if I'm stuck?
faq-accordion.answer: You can reach our support team via the Contact page, or browse this FAQ for quick answers. Pro and Scale plan users also get access to live chat support with a guaranteed 4-hour response time.

faq-accordion.question: Do you have video tutorials?
faq-accordion.answer: Yes. Check out the tutorial video on the Home page for a full walkthrough of the builder. We also maintain a growing library of short how-to videos in our Help Center.

faq-accordion.question: Can I request a feature?
faq-accordion.answer: Absolutely — we love hearing from users. Submit feature requests through the Contact page or vote on existing requests in our public roadmap at hotcode.ai/roadmap.
